description: A consumer requests use of a named capability under an agreed scope and receives an accepted outcome with a verifiable result reference. Field values below are placeholders for illustration only.

scope.note: Scope bounds what the consumer may invoke. The reach of a request is exactly its agreed scope and no broader.

input.note: Capability-specific input defined by the agreed contract for the named capability. Shape is capability-specific and out of scope for this example.

notes: outcome is one of: accepted | denied. A denied outcome follows the error-denial contract.
A consumer requests use of a capability by name and version; how that capability is produced or provisioned is out of scope for this public contract.
Holding a capability-use contract does not by itself grant entitlement; reach is bounded by the agreed scope.
result_ref is retrieved and verified via the status-result contract.
